lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is variable, ranging from narrow clusters at the mid-torso to wider gaps of approximately 2x the average width at the anterior and posterior terminals.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 4th vertical line from the anterior edge, splitting in the upper third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, and 10th vertical lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank without reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots arranged in a triangular cluster on the lower posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two horizontal spot alignments are visible: one on the upper hind limb and one parallel to the lower haunch margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white facial spot on the cheek and a distinct horizontal white band on the distal section of the upper forelimb.
